name: タムラテクスチャ特徴
description: 抽出します perceptual texture 特徴 (coarseness, コントラスト, directionality) を識別するために unnatural texture characteristics typical of AI生成の images.
mechanism: Computes Tamura coarseness を分析することで local average differences at multiple scales, and directionality by computing 勾配 orientation ヒストグラムs. AI images tend to have lower coarseness and more isotropic 勾配 分布s.
parameters: Scales: 5 levels (2^1 to 2^5), Gradient: Sobel operator, Orientation bins: 16
accuracy: 中程度 — 65-78%、補完的テクスチャ信号として最適
source: Tamura, H. et al. (1978) — Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception, IEEE SMC
useCase: Detecting unnatural texture properties in AI生成の surfaces and materials

references.title: Tamura, H. et al. (1978). Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception. IEEE SMC.

strengths:
• Perceptually meaningful 特徴
• Captures texture at multiple scales
• Independent of image content
• Fast computation
limitations:
• Lower standalone 精度
• Sensitive to image 解像度
• May overlap with other texture methods
• AI improving at texture generation
